data.name: Karbonetiq
data.description: Karbonetiq is a Santa Barbara, California-based CDR startup (founded 2022) developing surficial mineralization using alkaline industrial residues like slags and ash, processed through a low-cost passive aeration system with sensor-based MRV. In July 2025 it was selected in Frontier's fifth prepurchase round for 2,142 tons on behalf of Stripe, Shopify, and Google, and is backed by Evok Innovations.
